# Numly

> EngageAI™ is a hybrid AI-human leadership coaching platform that combines predictive analytics with competency frameworks to develop better leaders and build resilient teams.

Numly provides enterprise leadership development solutions powered by EngageAI™, integrating Birkman assessments, MIT competency frameworks, and machine learning to deliver measurable coaching outcomes. The platform serves organizations seeking to upskill managers and develop high-performing teams through data-driven, personalized development programs.

## Leadership Coaching Programs

- [Growth Leaders Development Framework](https://numly.io/connected-leadership-skills-framework-coaching-programs): Growth Leaders Development Framework and Leadership Essentials hybrid coaching programs with measurable performance outcomes.
- [60-Day Pilot Program](https://numly.io/60daypilot): 60-day pilot program for manager coaching using Skills Ontology and competency frameworks.
- [Free Leadership Courses for Professionals](https://numly.io/free-leadership-courses-for-professionals): Free 2025 leadership programs for career transitions and professional development.
